_comment: TEMPLATE — copy the blocks you need into your real Claude config at ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json. Replace YOUR_USERNAME and any tokens. Use ABSOLUTE paths. Find your node path with `command -v node` and your venv python at ~/mcp-servers/trainingpeaks/.venv/bin/python. NEVER commit your real config — it contains secrets. Make a backup before editing.

whoop._note: Point args at whichever file starts the WHOOP server (e.g. index.js or whoop.js). Credentials are read from the connector's .env; you can also inline them here as env vars.

intervals_icu._note: Only if you self-host an intervals.icu MCP. If you added intervals.icu as a hosted connector in Claude's settings instead, you do NOT need a block here.
